reden: Yes. The report explicitly documents the identical issue: multiple identical partial fills produce the same rental order hash, Storage.addRentals overwrites the same boolean without uniqueness, and the second stop reverts with OrderDoesNotExist, leaving part of the lender’s assets locked. This is covered in the findings “Identical partial fills create the same rental hash; second rental can never be stopped” (Storage.addRentals) and “Identical partial fills in one block collide on the rental order hash…” (Create._rentFromZone). The code paths and mechanism match the description (Signer._deriveRentalOrderHash, Create/Storage order creation, Storage.removeRentals reverts on second stop). Fixes suggested (ensuring uniqueness or disallowing partial orders/adding nonce) align, so fixing the reported issue would fix the described vulnerability.
